messages.author: e062e8df5492ceb1
messages.subject: Common Issues with R-INLA Installation
parts:
I am currently using R version 4.3.3, and I have encountered issues after installing INLA according to the official documentation. Despite my efforts to configure my R and Rtools environment correctly, I have not been able to resolve the problems,which I have found to be common among other users as well.

Initially, I installed version INLA_24.03.29, which is compatible with R-4.3.3. However, I encountered the following error when attempting to use the library:

library(INLA)

This is INLA_24.03.29 built 2024-03-29 13:04:47 UTC.

Following that, I executed my code:

n = 100; a = 1; b = 1; tau = 100

z = rnorm(n)

eta = a + b*z

scale = exp(rnorm(n))

prec = scale*tau

y = rnorm(n, mean = eta, sd = 1/sqrt(prec))

data = list(y=y, z=z)

formula = y ~ 1 + z

result = inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = data)

This resulted in the following error:

*** inla.core.safe: The inla program failed, but will rerun in case better initial values may help. try=1/1

Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :

The inla program call crashed.

Subsequently, I referred to the documentation which states that from version 23.05.30, INLA is built for R-4.3. For older R versions, it is necessary to install INLA versions compatible with each R version using the remotes package. I attempted to install version 23.05.30 as follows:

remotes::install_version("INLA",version="23.05.30",repos=c(getOption("repos"), INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep=TRUE)

Initially, I received an error indicating that the package could not be found. Upon further inspection of the link, I discovered that the actual package name was 23.05.30-1. I then downloaded the package locally and attempted to install it using:

install.packages("D:/Desktop/APC_BAPC_Package/R_packages/INLA_23.05.30-1.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")

After successfully loading the package, I ran my code again but encountered the following error:

install.packages("D:/Desktop/APC_BAPC_Package/R_packages/INLA_23.05.30-1.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")

> library(INLA)

载入需要的程辑包：Matrix

载入需要的程辑包：foreach

载入需要的程辑包：parallel

载入需要的程辑包：sp

This is INLA_23.05.30-1 built 2023-05-30 11:52:19 UTC.

 - See www.r-inla.org/contact-us for how to get help.

> n = 100; a = 1; b = 1; tau = 100

> z = rnorm(n)

> eta = a + b*z

> scale = exp(rnorm(n))

> prec = scale*tau

> y = rnorm(n, mean = eta, sd = 1/sqrt(prec))

> data = list(y=y, z=z)

> formula = y ~ 1+z

> result = inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = data)

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :

  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

*** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :

  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

*** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=2/2

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :

  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :

  *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.
